result.summary: The page is generally polished, but a few layout issues are visible around horizontally clipped content and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge, showing only a partial next chip without an obvious scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Keep the carousel clipping intentional but add a subtle fade, partial-chip indicator, or ensure horizontal scrolling is discoverable.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is visibly truncated at the right edge, including its title.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearly bounded horizontal carousel with scroll behavior, or adjust card sizing and spacing so the clipping appears deliberate.

issues.description: The next restaurant card in the “Popular right now” section is partially covered by the fixed bottom navigation bar, making its content difficult to view.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page or ensure the fixed navigation overlays only empty space rather than card content.
